Each component contributes to a scalar integrity score S ∈ [0,1]. The system assumes that these checks can be executed locally without network or AWS credentials. This leads to a credential-free execution kernel (C) which ensures E=1. If any of the validations fail, the system enters a failure regime where L is undefined or invalid. The Branch Protection Gate (B) acts as a control parameter that gates merge readiness (R). When B=true, R depends on the successful completion of all validations. The dual nature of this setup lies in its ability to enforce both internal consistency (via L) and external access control (via C), forming a robust guardrail against unauthorized or malformed code changes.
